subject.size_in_frame: her hand and forearm on the iron, about 0.30 of frame height; her face is out of frame above

second_subject.note: the large black iron handle and its whiplash escutcheon, the heaviest black in the frame.

headroom: no face, so no conventional headroom; the door head and one blind roundel occupy the top 0.22 of frame, giving the hand a weight of architecture above it.
horizon_eyeline: Lens at 1.25 m, square to the east wall. The mosaic dado runs level across at 0.74 of frame height. No eyeline in frame — the shot is a hand and an object.

layers.fg: her hand and forearm, hauling, the tendons doing the work
layers.mg: the iron handle, lock plate and the oak of the door
layers.bg: the mosaic dado below and one blind roundel above, catching a faint jewel glint of lamplight and nothing more

gaze.note: deliberately faceless: we join the second pass already defeated, so no expression is offered and none is needed.

balance: Compressed and frontal — iron centre-left, hand centre-right, dado under, roundel over. Four elements stacked with no air between them; the frame is as locked as the door.
leading_lines: The whiplash iron scrolls curl in on the handle from both sides, and the dado band runs flat under everything — organic lines contained by a straight one. Nothing leads out of frame.
eye_first: The handle, then the hand that cannot move it.
constraint_binding: Static — the first still frame since the reveal. After the travelling sh034 the composition deliberately stops dead, and it is a fragment rather than a figure, so the audience arrives mid-defeat with no re-establishment.
